notes.subject: האדרש אדרש
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute of דרש: 'should I be inquired of at all by them?' — translators split between 'consult' (BSB) and 'answer' (KJV); rendered as a rhetorical question of refusal.

notes.subject: האדרש אדרש
notes.rationale: Hebrew doubles the verb (infinitive absolute) for emphasis — 'asking, should I be asked?' — intensity flattened in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: piksa
notes.rationale: גלולים literally 'round logs' (D2: ol piksa bilong ol lain); the wood-shape picture is kept via 'piksa'.

notes.subject: pikinini man
notes.rationale: Direct address of Yahwe to Yehezkel, 'son of man'.

notes.subject: ol piksa long bel
notes.rationale: Idols set up in the heart — hidden things inside, unseen by the elders who sit before the prophet.

translation: Pikinini man, ol man ia ol i karim ol piksa bilong ol go antap long bel bilong ol, na ol i putim ⟨i⟩ — samting i save skruimapim bilong rong bilong ol — pastaim long ai bilong ol: sapos ol i askim, bai mi ken givim ansa long ol?
